misconceptions.description: Recording the observer's interpretation (confused, frustrated) as if it were observed data
misconceptions.trigger: learner's note states a mental state or verdict rather than an observable action or utterance
misconceptions.feedback: Log what was seen or heard. Move interpretations like 'confused' to a separate inference field for later analysis.

misconceptions.description: Writing a design verdict (this page is bad) into the live observation log
misconceptions.trigger: learner's protocol entry judges the design instead of capturing behavior anchored to a moment
misconceptions.feedback: Keep verdicts out of the log. Timestamp the moment and record the action; severity decisions come after patterns emerge.

misconceptions.description: Using free-form notes with no shared, predefined categories, making entries non-comparable across moderators
misconceptions.trigger: learner cannot tally an event consistently because notes lack shared codes anchored to task steps
misconceptions.feedback: Define shared observation categories tied to task steps before the session so events are counted the same way.
